keyEvents.text: Miguel Gutiérrez (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Igor Paixão (Marseille) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Jarell Quansah (Bayer 04 Leverkusen).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Afonso Moreira replaces Lucas Vázquez.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Equi Fernández replaces Robert Andrich.
Substitution, Marseille. Tadjidine Mmadi replaces Igor Paixão.
Substitution, Marseille. Tochukwu Nnadi replaces Geoffrey Kondogbia.
Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 0, Marseille 1. Amine Gouiri (Marseille) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ulisses Garcia.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Malik Tillman replaces Ibrahim Maza.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Montrell Culbreath replaces Jonas Hofmann.
Substitution, Marseille. Alexi Koum replaces Ulisses Garcia.
Substitution, Marseille. Neal Maupay replaces Amine Gouiri.
Tochukwu Nnadi (Marseille) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 0, Marseille 1.
